explication: Conductor is a durable workflow and agent execution platform. Users define or update a workflow, start an execution, and inspect or recover its persisted progress; workers and built-in tasks perform the work. The map also preserves the documented agent, scheduling, API, and UI capabilities. Several relationships are documented in the README; source-level edges are limited to relationships visible in sampled excerpts or the SOURCE INDEX, so unsampled wiring is omitted.
